description: NASA's Moon base will run at 34% oxygen, yet no cabin fabric or plastic has ever been fire-tested in microgravity at that level. 34 Percent turns NASA's microgravity combustion data (PSI, Saffire, SoFIE) into an AI fire-safety lab: a 3D Moon base fire simulator built from measured NASA fires, a gap finder and cited AI answers. https://34-percent.vercel.app
